source.title: Oh, Shiny!
source.description: A group of Dark Irons were recently captured with some particularly curious enchanted gemstones on their persons. These gemstones don't appear to be native to Azeroth and I simply MUST study more of them! They have their slaves digging the stuff up now deep in The Cauldron, and I need ye to head down there as fast as ye can and bring me some additional samples. I'll make it worth your while if you do!
source.objective: Master Smith Burninate at Thorium Point wants you to gather 8 Flamestone Clusters from Dark Iron Slavers in The Slag Pit. You can find the entrance to the Slag Pit inside the Cauldron, southeast of Thorium Point.
source.completion: They're beautiful! I can't wait to get these under my monoscope. Many thanks, <class>.
